title: Citation Envelope
description: Wire format for a single corpus citation surfaced by a grounded agent recommendation card (FR-RAG-AG-03) or a simulation chat SSE 'citation' event (FR-RAG-SIM-02). Canonical for spec 036 — every grounded UI surface and audit projection MUST conform.

jurisdiction.description: Issuing jurisdiction of the source document. Single value; jurisdiction-union retrieval (own + national + aidr) per FR-RAG-AG-04 / R-03 is performed at retrieval time, not at citation time.

topic.description: Topic slug from the CorpusEntry (e.g. 'evacuation-planning', 'aiims-span-of-control'). Free-form lowercase-kebab-case; validated against the live corpus index at retrieval time.

page.description: 1-indexed page within handbook.md. Anchors the rendered_url fragment.

source_url.description: Original publisher URL (PDF or HTML) — what the operator clicks through to inspect the publisher's authoritative copy.

rendered_url.description: Internal link to the rendered Markdown copy with page anchor: `/docs/corpus/<jurisdiction>/<topic>/handbook.md#page-N` (FR-RAG-AG-03).

sha256_of_chunk.description: SHA-256 of the retrieved chunk text (or, for metadata-only chunks, of the canonical (jurisdiction, topic, page, summary) tuple). MUST match a chunk_id in the originating RetrievalResult.chunks[]; otherwise this is a hallucinated citation and MUST be suppressed (FR-RAG-AG-05).

licence_mode.description: Licence mode of the underlying CorpusEntry. 'excluded' MUST never appear (server-side filter at retrieval — FR-RAG-IDX-02).

confidence.description: Per R-16: min(embedding_similarity, semantic_coherence, licence_mode_safety_gate). Below the per-agent threshold (R-10) the citation is downgraded but not suppressed; suppression only occurs on hallucination.

snippet.description: Verbatim excerpt from the chunk text. Conditionally present per R-11: REQUIRED iff licence_mode == 'full-text'; OMITTED iff licence_mode == 'metadata-only' (publisher does not grant excerpt redistribution).

examples.snippet: When the area is deemed safe, the Incident Controller authorises return of evacuees in coordination with NSW Police and the affected LGA…
